import numpy as np
# fit dA = a(t)+b(t)*A^n with n global scanned, a,b piecewise-linear in t on knots
knots=np.linspace(0.5,10,10)
def basis(tt):
    B=np.zeros((len(tt),len(knots)))
    for j in range(len(knots)):
        e=np.zeros(len(knots));e[j]=1
        B[:,j]=np.interp(tt,knots,e)
    return B
Bt=basis(t)
best=None
for n in np.arange(0.5,3.01,0.25):
    X=np.hstack([Bt, Bt*(A**n)[:,None]])
    c=np.linalg.lstsq(X,dA_dt,rcond=None)[0]
    r=np.std(dA_dt-X@c)
    print(n, round(r,4))
    if best is None or r<best[0]: best=(r,n,c)
r,n,c=best
print('n',n)
print('a(t)',np.round(c[:10],3))
print('b(t)',np.round(c[10:],3))
